m. (-रः)
Thorn apple, (Datura fastuosa): see the next.

m. (-रः)
Thorn apple, (Datura fastuosa.)
E.
धूष to make handsome, affix क्विप्, तूर् to be mischievous, affix क्; elegant but deleterious: the vowels are also both made short, as धुस्तुर, or both remain long, as in धूस्तूर; also written धुत्तूर.

m. (-रः)
The thorn apple, (Datura metel and fastuosa.)
E.
धूस् elegant, and तूर injurious: see धुस्तुर.

r. 10th cl. (धूशयति)
To make splendid or elegant; also धूष, and धूस.

r. 10th cl. (धूषयति)
To make splendid or elegant; also धूश and धूस.

r. 10th cl. (धूसयति)
To embellish, to make splendid or elegant.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Grey, of that colour.
m. (-रः)
1 Grey, (the colour.)
2 A jackass.
3 An oilman.
4 A camel.
5 A pigeon.
6 Any thing of a grey tint.
f. (-री)
A female Kinnara or chorister of heaven.
E.
धू to agitate, (the mind,) सर Uṇādi aff.

f. (-दा)
A plant commonly Śvetarāsnā.
E.
धूसर grey, and छद a leaf, grey-leaved.
